title: seo: open the most-searched tool pages with a short, sourced, dated direct answer
problem: AI answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Copilot) quote pages that state a fact plainly near the top with its source and date. A calculator page that only shows numbers after input gives them nothing to quote, even when the page knows the answer (a threshold, a fee rate, a rule of thumb).
evidence: Owner direction on SEO and AI discovery, prompts/goals.md ('SEO moves up a lot'); no measurement of AI citations exists yet
change: Pilot on 10 tool pages whose question has a single factual answer (tax thresholds, marketplace fee rates and the like): add one or two sentences under the H1 that answer it, cite the primary source and give an as-of date, taken from the venture's own calc data so they cannot drift. Make sure the FAQ schema the build derives picks it up. Do it only where the answer is a real fact the page already encodes; never invent one. Add a check that the lead's numbers match the calc module.
metric: pilot pages carrying a sourced lead; later, AI-referrer visits once platform/counter runs (P046)
source: Owner asked for SEO and AI-search action items in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-24

history.note: Pilot slice 1: 3 pages (1099-k-threshold-checker, hsa-contribution-limit-calculator, exempt-salary-threshold-checker) carry a data-answer-lead paragraph with source and as-of date; platform/pages/answer-lead.test.mjs checks every dollar figure against the venture's calc module. 7 pages remain. P052/P053 live verification was not possible: the cloud proxy returns 403 for duncan-haywood.github.io.
